notes: This is the cover of the Asamblea Legislativa plus the senators' attendance roll: no floor speech at all, so utterance_starts, events and headings are all legitimately empty and anything the parser attributes to a speaker on this page is a false positive. The roll is not an inserted document in the rule-3 sense either — it is a printed list of who was present, never read out here. Judgement call worth recording: 'VERSIÓN TAQUIGRÁFICA' / 'ASAMBLEA LEGISLATIVA' are centred and bold and could be read as headings, but they are the masthead of the volume rather than a section heading of the debate, so I filed the whole block, and the two bold roll labels 'SENADORES PRESENTES:' and 'AUSENTES, CON AVISO:', under furniture. There is no running header and no footer on this page. TYPOGRAPHY, two things that look like defects in the original: a stray isolated period sits alone in the left margin beside the Hidalgo line, and one roll entry is punctuated 'MORANDINI. Norma E.' with a period where every other entry uses a comma.
